project_type: Next.js 14 full-stack DApp + Solidity contracts, integrated with MetaMask/Wagmi, Sepolia testnet
build_system: npm workspaces. Frontend: Next.js, contracts compiled via Hardhat. No monorepo package.json split; single package.json at root.
build_command: npm run blockchain:compile && cd dapp && npm run build (estimated; verify package.json for exact Next.js build script)
test_command: npx hardhat test (for contracts). Next.js: no explicit test command found; use npm run dev for manual testing.
verification_instructions: Documented in design.md (section 10): check tokens CSS (--fundo #f5f1e7, --sup-1 #fffdf8, --texto-1 #1e2a22, --verde-600 #1f6440, etc.); contrast mín 4.5:1 em corpo; números tabulares (tabular-nums); tipografia em --serifa ou --fonte conforme contexto; componentes use raio --raio (16px); espaçamento em múltiplos de 4 (4,8,12,16,24,32px); nenhum emoji em produto (glifos de texto só); nenhum hex hardcoded em componente.
snapshot_or_generated_files: No artifacts generated during build. Contracts compiled to blockchain/artifacts/ (git-ignored). design.md specifies reference screenshots in prototipo-agrochain/design/ (01-painel.png ... 16-detalhe-topo.png), generated by design/capturar.js but not enforced in build.
environment_constraints: MetaMask connected to Sepolia testnet only; no mainnet deployments. .env file at workspace root (secrets). Next.js dev server on :3000 (default). Blockchain contracts: 0.8.37 Solidity, OpenZeppelin 5.6.1 contracts, ethers.js 6.x for frontend.
contribution_requirements: Follow design.md tokens rigorously: no hex values hardcoded in components, all colors from :root CSS variables. Use existing pattern from marketplace.ts (mock data, ABI stubs, helper functions). Sidebar must expand/collapse sections; new routes added to navSections array and shouldSectionBeExpanded. Commit per feature, never --amend after hook failure.
key_patterns: Marketplace (marketplace/page.tsx, lib/contracts/marketplace.ts) and Producer (producer/page.tsx) establish frontend patterns: mock data in utils file, filterListings-style helpers, status badges with color logic, KPI cards in cards layout. Design tokens in globals.css :root. Sidebar seeded from navSections array with label/href/icon. useAccount() hook from wagmi for address. Truncation of addresses: truncateAddress(addr) pattern used.
relevant_files: dapp/src/lib/contracts/marketplace.ts (pattern for buyer.ts utils: mock data, ABI, helpers)
dapp/src/app/marketplace/page.tsx (UI pattern: filters, tables, KPI cards)
dapp/src/app/producer/page.tsx (UI pattern: sidebar integration, mock data rendering)
dapp/src/app/globals.css (design tokens defined here; extend if needed)
design.md (design system source of truth: colors, typography, spacing, components)
blockchain/contracts/AgroChainMarketplace.sol (pattern for AgroChainBuyer.sol: struct layout, events, storage vars)
blockchain/contracts/AgroChainPayments.sol (escrow pattern if Reviews need payment/deposit logic)
directory_structure: Root: agrochain (monorepo root). blockchain/: contracts (Solidity .sol files, ABI artifacts post-compile), scripts (deploy, test scripts), tests (Hardhat tests). dapp/: Next.js app root. src/: app (pages), components (reusable UI), lib (utilities, contract ABIs, helpers), types (TypeScript interfaces). deploy commands in package.json scripts.
